capabilities: Generate candidate relations between notes in a sidebar review queue
Accept, ignore, or insert suggested links with persistent decision states
Detect conflicts, stale suggestions, broken links, and orphan notes
Strengthen discovery using a maintained entity-relationship layer
Export an MCP server file so AI agents can query and update relations
extras: Hosted service via Bondie with a Free membership and optional payments; desktop-only, targets Obsidian 1.8.7+; advanced local engine may require a Python runtime; further documentation lives in PRIVACY.md, SECURITY.md, and an Engineering README.
problem: Obsidian offers no automated way to discover candidate relationships between notes, track human review of those suggestions, or flag conflicts, stale links, and orphan notes as a vault grows.

relations.evidence: The default experience starts with Continue with Bondie. Sign in once, use the managed Understory service
Open Settings -> Understory -> AI agents when Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or another assistant should query the current vault.

requires.name: own API key for advanced bring-your-own-key mode
MCP-capable assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT for agent access

summary: Relation-discovery and review system that proposes related notes, records your accept/ignore decisions, and surfaces vault maintenance risks.
